newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo edges up against mark at close.
newsitem.headline: Escudo edges up against mark at close.

text.p: 1735 GMT - The escudo edged higher against the mark at the close, but dealers said the direction of the Portuguese currency was unclear after a volatile session dominated by concerns over the European single currency. Dealers said the escudo should remain in a range between 100.30 and 100.60 per mark. The escudo closed at 100.43/46, compared with 100.55/58 at the opening.
